mapper.update: UPDATE organization_approval_proxy SET revoked_by=#{actor},revoked_reason=#{reason},revoked_at=#{atAt},revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_approval_proxy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND definition_id=#{definitionId} AND principal_id=#{principalId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND starts_at<#{startsAt} AND ends_at>#{endsAt})
SELECT p.* FROM organization_approval_proxy p WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.* FROM organization_approval_proxy p WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (principal_id=#{personId} OR substitute_id=#{substituteId}) AND id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.*,principal.subject AS principal_subject FROM organization_approval_proxy p JOIN organization_person principal ON principal.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND principal.id=p.principal_id JOIN organization_person substitute ON substitute.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND substitute.id=p.substitute_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND substitute.subject=#{subject} AND principal.active=TRUE AND principal.approval_eligible=TRUE AND substitute.active=TRUE AND substitute.approval_eligible=TRUE AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND p.created_at<=#{observedAt} AND p.starts_at<=#{startsAt} AND p.ends_at>#{endsAt} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.* FROM organization_approval_proxy p WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} FOR NO KEY UPDATE FOR UPDATE
